## 🐛 Fixed

- **The production image stays on OpenCloud 7.2.** On 17 November OpenCloud moved its `latest` tag to 4.0.10, an older long-term line, and the next build of `production` would have picked it up. The image now follows OpenCloud 7 directly and brings 7.2.6. OpenCloud 9.1, the new production line, needs manual upgrade steps, so it gets a release of its own. `rolling` is not affected.
